name: aa_pickup_followup
title: Pick-up follow-up (one manual step)
start: Load the Doc Mitchell save again (stimpaks still on the shelf). Empties your inventory.

steps.query:
float fM
ref rF
float fV
Begin Function { }
let fM := GetModIndex "FalloutNV.esm"
let rF := BuildRef fM 86377
let fV := player.GetItemCount rF
SetFunctionValue fV
End
steps.label: a00 stimpaks at start

steps.query:
float fM
ref rF
float fV
Begin Function { }

End
